powers.text: It clanks to life as a lobster-shaped submersible. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: A sealed iron barrel that becomes a lobster-shaped submersible vehicle.
text: This item first appears to be a Large sealed iron barrel weighing 500 pounds. The barrel has a hidden catch, which can be found with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check. Releasing the catch unlocks a hatch at one end of the barrel, allowing two Medium or smaller creatures to crawl inside. Ten levers are set in a row at the far end, each in a neutral position, able to move up or down. When certain levers are used, the apparatus transforms to resemble a giant lobster with claws, legs, and a tail. In the game, it is a vehicle for travel underwater; Barovia's lakes are too small to need it.
